truck.source: Council Directive 96/53/EC, Annex I 1.2(a) (width 2.55 m) and 1.3 (height 4.00 m), consolidated text of 14/08/2019, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:01996L0053-20190814
truck.length_source: 96/53/EC Annex I 1.1 (articulated vehicle 16.50 m) and 1.6 (king pin to rear of the semi-trailer 12.00 m); beyond them only on a special permit, Art. 4(3)
truck.deck_requirement_source: 4.00 m - H_tr: the road height limit minus the transport height of (i)

vehicle.name: Kaessbohrer K.SLL 2/2H-18/20, 2-axle extendable low-bed semi-trailer (well type)
vehicle.well_thickness_source: Kaessbohrer, K.SLL 2 test article: 'In the standard configuration, the platform is 200 mm thick' (https://kaessbohrer.com/en/kaessbohrers-k-sll-2-has-tested-by-an-industry-specialist-695-pg, read 2026-10-07)
vehicle.ground_clearance_source: Kaessbohrer newsroom: K.SLL 2 'has the lowest loading height with the ground clearance of just 100 mm' (https://kaessbohrer.com/en/newsroom/kassbohrer-strengthened-the-fleet-of-germany-s-rudebusch-771-n); equals 0.300 - 0.200
vehicle.bogie_deck_height_source: Kaessbohrer, K.SLL 2 test article (DE): 'Hoehe Fahrwerk: 950' mm (https://kaessbohrer.com/de/kaessbohrers-k-sll-2-wurde-von-einem-branchenspezialisten-getestet-695-pg)
vehicle.ride_height_note: the 300 mm well height is the air-suspension ride height (ECAS option: 300/340 mm, same test article); the parked trailer is drawn at ride height (assumption)
vehicle.extension_note: product page Pe 5,550 mm; the test article says the well telescopes 5.5 m in 50 cm steps
vehicle.floor: wooden floor in the well between the steel side frames
vehicle.floor_source: Kaessbohrer, K.SLL 2 test article: wooden floor in three segments; Doll vario T2H: 45 mm spruce floor 'zwischen den Flachbettrahmen' (drawn as one floor 45 mm thick between two 80 mm side frames; the frame width is schematic)
vehicle.twin_source: Kaessbohrer, K.SLL 2 test article: 'dual tires 245/70 R 17,5 eightfold plus spare wheel' (https://kaessbohrer.com/en/kaessbohrers-k-sll-2-has-tested-by-an-industry-specialist-695-pg)

tyre.source: Michelin XTA2 Energy 245/70R17.5: '31.2 inch / 792 mm', loaded radius '14.2 inch / 361 mm', https://business.michelinman.com/tires/michelin-xta-2-energy
tyre.twin_spacing_source: Michelin XTA2 Energy: minimum dual spacing '10.6 inch / 270 mm'
tyre.twin_source: Goldhofer NA STZ-H/L 6 'Twin tires: 245/70 R 17.5' (https://www.goldhofer.com/en/north-america/semi-lowloader/stz-h/l-6); Fliegl 'Twin tyres'

other_models.axle_spacing_source: Doll vario T2H 'Radstand: 1.360 mm' (https://www.doll-heavyhaulage.com/de/schwertransport-fahrzeuge/tiefbett-sattelauflieger/2-achs-tiefbett-vario-t2h-s3fs21); Goldhofer STZ-VL 1,360/1,510 mm
other_models.width_over_tyres_source: Nooteboom EURO low-loader bogie width 2520 (https://www.nooteboom.com/trailers/eurotrailer/euro-low-loader/), another model

schematic.kingpin_to_front_note: assumed: the closed trailer then meets the 12.00 m king-pin-to-rear limit exactly (13.21 - 1.21, Annex I 1.6); swing clearance (king pin to the vertical face of the neck) 1.94 m, within the 1.90-2.40 m of Goldhofer STEPSTAR but below the 2.03-2.79 m range of the Rogers glossary; front corner radius 1.75 m within the 2.04 m of Annex I 4.4; rear axle 0.79 m from the rear end (wheelbase taken as king pin to the centre of the axle group, the only reading that fits the maker's numbers)
schematic.gooseneck_depth_note: not sourced for the K.SLL 2 (a dealer listing gives about 0.45 m); drawn schematically
schematic.landing_legs_note: position and type not sourced (a dealer listing of the K.SLL 2 mentions a hydraulic traverse for the detachable gooseneck); two legs under the gooseneck, 0.06 m in front of the neck: the posts lie outside the 1.94 m swing clearance circle, their 0.30 m pads on the road reach 0.05 m inside it; drawn schematically
schematic.rear_step_note: the step from the well up to the deck over the axles is not sourced: 0.10 m long, 0.15 m in front of the front tyres (whether this leaves room to steer them to the maker's 42 deg depends on the unsourced pivot position)
schematic.underrun_note: UN R58: bottom at most 0.45 m above the road, section at least 0.12 m high, at most 0.20 m in from the rear, at most 0.10 m narrower each side than the axle (https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:42019X0272)
schematic.extension_floor_note: the floor of the extended well is an option of such trailers (Langendorf SATBUEV), drawn
schematic.well_underside_note: flat underside over the whole extended well, drawn as one 2.54 m wide slab; the maker gives the clearance, not the shape (schematic)
schematic.neck_note: the vertical front of the well up to the gooseneck, 0.45 m long, drawn schematically
schematic.rear_section_note: deck over the axles drawn as a 60 mm plate on two main beams, with rear lights and mud flaps (schematic; only its height 0.95 m is sourced)
schematic.parked_state_note: drawn at the 0.30 m air-suspension ride height with undeflected tyres; no load securing, side markers or spare wheel are drawn

knee_walls_footline_m.source: design input: height of the foot line above the floor

person_height_m.source: a person of 1.80 m for scale

joint_m.source: no joint: the verified slabs are rendered exactly; panel edges are drawn as lines
